cache_dir.description: Directory where sysv-rc-conf stores cache files (priority numbers, old config). Corresponds to --cache.

root_dir.description: The root directory to use for path resolution. Corresponds to --root.

verbose_file.description: File path to print verbose information to. Corresponds to --verbose.

runlevels.description: List of runlevels to affect operations on. Corresponds to --level. Items can be 'S' or '0-9'.

services.description: List of services to configure. Each item is a map of service properties.
